description_en: Performs a full update of the specified workflow. The owner, data source, scheduling resource group, description, and trigger run mode (normal, dry run, or paused) can be synchronized to Data Studio
description_zh: 以全量更新的方式，更新指定工作流。支持同步更新到数据开发的字段：责任人、数据源、调度资源组、描述信息、触发运行模式（正常、空跑、暂停）
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public update-workflow --id 1234 --name 'My Workflow' --owner 1000 --trigger Type=Scheduler --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en: The client unique code of the workflow, which is used to implement asynchronous and idempotent operations. If you do not specify this parameter when creating a workflow, the system automatically generates one and uniquely binds it to the resource ID. If you specify this parameter when updating or deleting a resource, it must be the same as the client unique code used during creation
parameters.help_zh: 工作流的客户端唯一码，用于实现异步和幂等。创建时如果不指定，系统将自动生成，该代码将与资源ID进行唯一绑定。更新、删除资源时如果指定该参数，应与创建时的客户端唯一码保持统一
parameters.name: client_unique_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance generation mode. Valid values:
T+1: Generates the instance on the next day.
Immediately: Generates the instance immediately. Note: Periodic instances are generated normally only if the scheduled time of the workflow is at least 10 minutes after the workflow publish time. Real-time instance generation is not supported during the full instance generation period (22:00 to 24:00). You can submit and publish workflows during this period, but instances are not regenerated after submission
parameters.help_zh:
实例生成模式。

T+1（第二天生成）
Immediately（立即生成）。注意：工作流定时时间在工作流发布时间点十分钟后的周期实例才会正常生成。全量转实例期间（22:00~24:00点期间）不能进行实时转实例，可以提交发布工作流，但提交后不会重新生成实例
parameters.name: instance_mode
